slate_notes: Sunday Nov 22 (NFL Sunday): NFL (11 games), NBA (7), NHL (5). Priced NFL receptions for all 11 games, NBA assists+rebounds for 7, NHL SOG for 5 with pl price (30 credits; per-book devig median, 2+ books, unders shaded -3 pts), then checked against ESPN game logs, injury reports and NFL weather/spreads. 12 legs in 12 different games: 10 overs, 2 volume unders (Fant U1.5 rec, Benn U1.5 SOG). Rain is forecast at CHI, PHI, NYG and CAR. Skipped: Dawson Knox O1.5 rec (Kincaid doubtful, but 3/8 L8 at 2+ with Kincaid out earlier), Heiskanen O1.5 SOG (3/10), Crosby O1.5 (B2B, 6/10, same game as Benn), John Carlson O1.5 (5/10), Anthony Davis O1.5 ast (5/10), Obi Toppin O3.5 reb (0/6 recent), Brenton Strange O2.5 (three straight 2s), Aaron Jones O1.5 (reduced role), O0.5 NFL lines (Turpin, Monangai, Mason; unlikely to match app lines), Myles Price/Javonte Williams unders (role expansion from Addison/Ferguson outs), Gui Santos/Paul Reed assists unders (role expansion), SGA O3.5 reb (cooldown, missed Nov 20, same line), Aaron Gordon O1.5 ast and Kyshawn George O3.5 ast (same games as Okoro and Bane). Cooldown: no conflicts. Back-to-backs: Pritchard (BOS) and Boeser (VAN). Early starts: Miller 12:40 PM, all NFL 1:00 PM except Jeanty 4:25 PM; Wiggins 3:40 PM. Confirm each line in the app and skip Goblin/Demon lines.

legs.reasoning: Tuten is JAX's lead back (12-26 carries a game) and a steady checkdown target: 2+ catches in 7 of his last 8 (the one miss was a 12-carry game at BAL with 0 targets). Targets have been 2-4 a game. Rain is forecast at MetLife, which tends to shorten passing and favor RB dump-offs, and JAX is a 6-point road favorite, so a normal script keeps him on the field. Five books price O1.5 between -173 and -200; per-book devig median 60.9%. Clear of the 53.5-54.9% break-evens. Confirm the app line is 1.5 and not a Goblin.
legs.injury_notes: JAX injury report has no skill-position outs (C Hainsey, DE Striggow out). ESPN NFL injuries checked 9:50 AM ET.

legs.reasoning: Volume under, not a blowout under. Fant is a low-target TE in NO's offense: 1-2 targets in each of his last 5 games (0,1,2,0,1 catches) and 0-1 catches in 4 of the last 5. Books price the under -243 to -250 (beyond -180), justified by volume: 1.4 targets/game over the last 5 with no route-share increase and no NO pass-catcher ruled out (the Saints' outs are OL/CB). Rain is forecast at Soldier Field, which should suppress passing. Risk: NO is an 11.5-pt underdog, so trailing could add pass volume and the leg can lose on a pass-heavy catch-up script; the volume thesis is his 1-2 targets per game, not game flow. Raw 4-book median under 66.9%, shaded -3 to 63.9%.
legs.injury_notes: NO outs: OT Richards, C McCoy, OT Fuaga, CB Emerson (no pass-catchers). No new role expansion for Fant. ESPN checked 9:50 AM ET.
